title: Design: Uncategorized's page shows grayed matrix and Tax Exempt fields
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks Products And Services field shows.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • A grayed Pricing Matrix box reading General Matrix and a grayed Tax Exempt checkbox show under the title.
  • The QuickBooks Products And Services picker shows in its usual style, as in picture 8.3.
